Plain bracket autolink <https://example.com/path>.

URL with > inside: <https://example.com/?q=a>b> — first > closes.

URL with escape attempt: <https://example.com/\>not-escapable> — backslash doesn't help.

Inside link: [text](<https://example.com/path with spaces>) — angle-bracket dest with spaces.

Empty angle brackets: <>.

Mailto: <user@example.com>.
